observation_source: Human photograph of the panic screen
panic: NATIVE_UFS smmu: SMMU AArch64 stage 1 unsupported slot=4294967295 smr=0 s2cr=0 @NativeUfs.cpp:442
result: With the vendored driver reading IDR0/1/2 at 0x0/0x4/0x8 and auto-reuse scanning every exact SID, the planner rejects the SMMU: IDR0 bit 30 is clear, so the driver cannot conclude AArch64 stage 1 support.
limits: This establishes that the SM8550/alioth SMMU model does not match the T970 SM8250 registers; it does not identify the correct SM8250 IDR layout or prove the SMMU unusable by another implementation.
